title: Max with a constraint
prompt: Implement `static T MaxOf<T>(IEnumerable<T> items) where T : IComparable<T>` returning the largest element; throws `InvalidOperationException` for null or empty input.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: One method, three types — the constraint unlocks CompareTo for each.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Empty input has no max — that's an exceptional condition, not a default value.
